reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape; the rendered text is unchanged from the originals.

Cited paragraphs support compliance: p0047 is a mutual employee non-solicit (not a restraint on the businesses we operate or products we buy/build), p0020 is ordinary licence-scope language limiting resale of Contractor's pre-existing proprietary materials, and p0019 confirms Contractor may serve other clients while imposing nothing on Company.

No field-of-use, exclusivity, territory or competing-product restriction binding the Customer is present, so the preferred position ('no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer') is met; the deterministic check also confirms no open-ended compete restriction remains.

Minor caveat only: p0019's lead-in ('Company agrees that, notwithstanding anything to the contrary set forth herein:') introduces sub-clauses not quoted here, but nothing in the supplied record shows a restrictive covenant, so the compliant classification stands as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
